mainText: Hello, Verona! At 10 AM, here is today's balanced dish. We are enjoying fair conditions and a comfortable 70 degrees around Badger Prairie County Park. If you look up tonight at 5:50 PM, you can catch the International Space Station traveling low near the horizon from the northwest over Middleton near Verona High School toward Fitchburg and Madison in the east northeast.

In city news, City of Verona offices and the recycling center will be closed on Thursday, November 26, and Friday, November 27, for Thanksgiving, pushing Thursday trash collection to Friday. Additionally, the city is planning a new Public Works and Utilities facility to handle population growth, featuring expanded space, sustainable materials, and a new tree nursery.

Local events kick off today with Yoga at Insight Wellness. Looking ahead to tomorrow, you can enjoy trivia at Hop Haus Brewing Company or Lake Lou-ee Brewing, and later this week on Friday, November 27, Wisconsin Brewing Company is celebrating 50 years of craft brewing.

In the police recap, on Saturday, November 8th, officers responded to a single vehicle crash on South Main Street where a car hit a tree and light pole before catching fire, resulting in the driver being arrested for O W I.
Over at Culver's, the store is open today until 10:00 PM featuring Butter Pecan as today's flavor of the day, with OREO REESE'S Cheesecake coming up tomorrow.
